sloka: शोणिताक्षस्ततः क्षिप्रमसिचर्म समाददे।उत्पपात दिवं क्रुद्धो वेगवानविचारयन् ।। ६.७६.८ ।।
transliteration: śoṇitākṣastataḥ kṣipramasicarma samādade।utpapāta divaṁ kruddho vegavānavicārayan ।। 6.76.8 ।।

translations.english: Thereupon enraged Sonitaksha, quickly sprang up to the sky at high speed with sword and shield.
